An earlier draft of this record wrongly reported no fixture existing anywhere for family 1 -- corrected in docs/notes/p037-formal-kernel.md #10.7a, which also traces frontend/roslyn/OwnSharp.Extractor/Program.cs's ParameterIsStable to show the compound- and capture-write members share guard-mutated's own AssignmentExpressionSyntax code path (so they are not independent code-path witnesses) and that increment/decrement cannot apply to a G-V1-eligible guard (bool has no ++/-- in C#) -- so family 1 is fully discharged without a new corpus/p036-bakeoff fixture.
